run_mnist_permutations_default: run the script to generate 3 permuted MNIST tasks using default settings and seed 0
run_mnist_permutations_custom_tasks: run the script with --n_tasks 10 to generate 10 permuted MNIST task splits
run_mnist_permutations_custom_seed: run the script with --seed 42 to generate reproducible permuted MNIST tasks
run_mnist_permutations_custom_io: run the script with --i /data/raw --o output.pt to specify custom input and output paths
run_mnist_permutations_all_args: run the script with all arguments to generate 5 permuted MNIST tasks with seed 7 to a custom file
